blocks.text: The missing link between the port and the GPU floor

Purview has installed and operated AI data centres at scale, and every programme met the same friction: hardware stuck at customs, integrated in the wrong place, or waiting weeks for a spare. GigaPort removes that friction with one hub that imports under bond, integrates to OEM standard and feeds Purview DC’s installation teams, so an AI factory starts production sooner.
From landed pallet to production-ready rack

items.title: Bonded import and custody
items.body: Hardware held in a customs-bonded facility until deployment, deferring duty and keeping title with the owner.

items.title: Rack integration
items.body: Servers, networking and power assembled into racks to OEM reference designs and client build sheets.

items.title: Testing and burn-in
items.body: Power-on, firmware, burn-in and cluster-level validation with evidence captured before despatch.

items.title: Secure delivery to site
items.body: GPU-grade transport and last-mile delivery to the data centre floor, timed to the installation plan.

items.title: Reverse logistics and ITAD
items.body: Returns, RMA to OEM, certified data destruction, asset recovery and recycling.

items.title: OEM secure centres and spares
items.body: Dedicated caged custody suites per OEM and consigned spares in India for rapid fault response.

items.title: Land
items.body: Hardware arrives and moves into bonded custody with full asset tracking.

items.title: Integrate
items.body: Racks are built to the reference design, cabled and labelled.

items.title: Test
items.body: Burn-in and validation run; results form the acceptance record.

items.title: Deliver
items.body: Racks ship to site in sequence with Purview DC’s installation schedule.

items.title: Support and return
items.body: Spares, RMAs and end-of-life handled through the same hub.

items.title: A hub, a partner network and a technician academy
items.body: Purview operates the facility and its logistics, works with global distribution partners for hardware supply, and runs a training and certification academy for data centre technicians that feeds both GigaPort and Purview DC’s floors.

items.a: Purview’s customs-bonded hub in Hyderabad for importing, integrating, testing and delivering AI and high-tech hardware, with reverse logistics and OEM support.
No. It is operations-only: clients and OEMs keep title; GigaPort provides custody, integration and logistics.

items.q: What is the benefit of bonded custody?
items.a: Duty is deferred until hardware is deployed, and hardware can be staged in India close to the data centre.

items.q: How does it connect to Purview DC?
items.a: Racks leave GigaPort tested and sequenced for Purview DC’s installation teams, one accountable chain from port to production.
